cards.subtitle: Deterministic Agentic VLM Visual QA & Localized Self-Healing Inpainting pipeline evaluation (grounding localized <6% anatomical/prop/OCR defects via GPT-5.4 Vision / Qwen-2.5-VL + GroundingDINO + SAM-2, healing only the cropped ROI via MediaPipe Pose/Depth ControlNet inpainting while freezing 94% of approved pixels so amortized unit repair cost c_heal(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_heal = 1.0000x across all 17 QA gates u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive full-clip random seed rerolling (which discards 94%-approved compositions and inflates GPU spend by 1 + u to 1.2500x at G4, 1.5000x at G8, and 2.0000x at G16 across 16/17 gates) and 64-region VLM rubric quadrature.

good_fit: Unmanned overnight e-commerce & short-drama AIGC factories requiring >99.5% anatomical/prop accuracy without human QA bottlenecks
Isolating <6% localized hand, finger, cup-handle, or gibberish-sign defects via GroundingDINO + SAM-2 while freezing 94% of approved pixels
Enforcing a 2-hop automated inpainting circuit breaker before escalating <0.5% edge cases to a Human-in-the-Loop Dead-Letter Queue
not_for: Discarding a 94%-perfect generation to fix a 6th finger via global random seed rerolling
Publishing raw batch AIGC posters directly to ad networks without VLM anatomical and OCR Levenshtein verification
Unbounded agent retry loops with no max-hop circuit breaker
